svg.title: mini-AGI has three learning paths and one of them is measured
svg.desc: An original diagram of the pinned mini-AGI repository. The corpus training run has a published forgetting probe with the trunk at 0.1x. Reading your own files runs at the shipped config's 3e-4 rate and checks held-out loss only if a held-out folder exists. Chatting through serve.py learns by default, writes weights to disk, has no held-out check, and its cost is labelled unmeasured in the code.
svg.text: Three ways mini-AGI learns, one of them measured
Pinned at commit efd4a168. Defaults as shipped in config.yaml, train.py, and serve.py.
Trunk at 0.1x of the experts' rate. Held-out loss, scored during the run, steers the rate.
Published probe: 524,000 characters of chess, seven unread subjects moved +0.0067 nats.
README says --lr defaults to 5e-5; the shipped config makes it 3.0e-4, the training rate.
Before/after check runs only if data/val exists. The README's --mix flag is not a read option.
Steps every training.chunk characters at 3e-4 and writes weights to disk. No held-out check.
live.py: cost in the current regime is UNKNOWN; an earlier denser variant cost +0.65 nats.
